baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative سَبِّحْ is mediated by بِٱسْمِ and directed to رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worshipful utterance and action join the clearing of the Lord from defect; the name is the explicit medium, while lordship and greatness identify sovereign nurture and power.

activation_trace.role: Worship, prayer, remembrance, and gratitude supply the imperative's enacted and uttered mode.
Clearing and distancing from defect supply the declaration's negative, purifying function.
Naming as designation makes the Lord's name, rather than an unnamed feeling, the articulated medium.
Ownership, mastery, and obeyed sovereignty identify the one to whom the declaration is returned.
Magnitude, force, and exalted rank give positive content to the Lord's greatness.

changed_reading.before: A generic command to praise God.
changed_reading.after: Use the great Lord's own name as the medium for worshipfully declaring both his power and his freedom from every defect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَبِّحْ at word 1 and ٱسْمِ at word 2 permit a motion-and-elevation resonance alongside the ordinary imperative.
baseline_models.mechanism: Swimming or coursing, wide movement in speech, the rising of a visible thing, and spreading good repute combine into an image of the great name being carried outward rather than held as a static label.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and rapid coursing contribute the image of sustained movement.
Wide going, coming, and movement in speech turn that motion into circulation through life and language.
Elevation supplies the upward vector of the circulating name.
Good repute spreading abroad makes the name's movement publicly audible and consequential.
Honor and acknowledged rank explain why the name is elevated in circulation.

changed_reading.before: Recite a stationary formula of glorification.
changed_reading.after: Let the honored Lord's name rise and course outward through speech and conduct; this remains an image layered onto, not a replacement for, ritual glorification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated inspection questions distinguish human contact with materials from origination and transformation. The concluding imperative therefore performs a causal clearing: apparent means are denied independent authorship and the outcome is reassigned by name to the sovereign Lord.

activation_trace.role: Clearing and distancing remove false causal predicates from the Lord and from apparent agents.
Explicit designation makes the reassignment of agency nameable rather than merely implicit.
Sovereign ownership receives the productive agency withdrawn from human handling.
The attention-demanding inquiry initiates an audit of what the addressees actually cause.
Origination distinguishes creating a being from merely supplying a proximate material act.
Causing something to assume a condition makes drinkability, and its possible reversal, an assigned state.
Bringing the fire-tree into existence repeats the contrast between using a thing and originating its capacity.

structural_cues: The recurring 'Have you considered?' and 'Is it you ... or We?' frames move from observation to an agency contrast.
The result-link at the opening of 56:74 closes the sequence as a consequence rather than an isolated formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated inspection prompts, explicit human/divine alternatives, and a final result-linked imperative; I infer that the imperative completes their agency audit. A live alternative is that the final link only continues the discourse and the command remains a general summary.

changed_reading.before: Glorify after noticing impressive natural phenomena.
changed_reading.after: After auditing reproduction, growth, water, and fire, clear away the illusion that handling a means equals originating its result, and return productive agency by name to the great Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reproductive, agricultural, hydrological, and arboreal sequences activate رب as one who tends, repairs, feeds, and increases a thing stage by stage. Lordship becomes an ongoing developmental relation, so glorification acknowledges hidden maturation rather than only remote ownership.

activation_trace.role: Repair, completion, and gradual nurture supply the governing developmental mechanism.
The split root's feeding and growth branch sharpens lordship as causing living increase.
Generative fluid supplies a latent beginning whose formed outcome is not yet present.
Growing up under nurture supplies the transition from beginning to developed form.
Causing seed to grow distinguishes cultivation of the result from the human act of sowing.
Delivering water supplies the enabling input by which staged nurture continues.
Sending and delivering the water gives the enabling input a directed source.
The trunked tree carries progressive growth into the final fire example.

structural_cues: Each example begins with an accessible material or human act and proceeds to an outcome whose development exceeds that act.
The sequence ranges across body, crop, rain, and tree while preserving the same human-action/divine-outcome contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies latent beginnings, growth, delivered water, and a grown tree; I infer one cross-domain arrow of progressive tending into mature capacity. The live alternative is that these are independent proofs of power with no special emphasis on the nurturing sense of رب.

changed_reading.before: Praise the Lord chiefly as owner and ruler.
changed_reading.after: Glorify the Lord as the one who carries hidden potential through feeding, growth, repair, and completion until a usable living capacity appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death, failed escape, pulverized crop, deprivation, and bitter water expose the reversible edge of ordinary benefits. Greatness is read not only in producing things but in continuously holding their life, yield, access, and fitness for use away from collapse.

activation_trace.role: Clearing removes the assumption that stable benefits maintain themselves independently.
Power and magnitude characterize the capacity to govern both beneficial states and their reversals.
Loss of life and force establishes the most comprehensive reversal of creaturely usability.
Escaping or eluding a pursuer supplies the denied possibility of outrunning the governing power.
Dry matter broken into fragments turns expected crop into unusable residue.
Deprivation names the human result when an expected benefit is withheld.
Salty bitter water shows that presence of the material does not guarantee fitness for its intended use.

structural_cues: The sequence repeatedly places a beneficial outcome beside an explicit counterfactual reversal.
Human laments after crop failure expose dependence on conditions normally treated as stable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destructive alternatives to life, crop, access, and drinkability; I infer that their ordinary nonoccurrence is itself continuous preservation. A live alternative is that the counterfactuals function only as threats and proofs, without making preservation a distinct object of glorification.

changed_reading.before: Glorify the Lord for spectacular acts of creation.
changed_reading.after: Glorify the great Lord also for the quiet maintenance by which living and useful states do not at every moment become death, debris, deprivation, or bitterness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Latent fire is drawn from wood, then explicitly made reminder and practical provision for those in empty country. The final verbal imperative converts a material reminder at the point of use into named remembrance and worship.

activation_trace.role: Remembrance, worship, and gratitude supply the human response into which the material reminder culminates.
The designation of the Lord turns an encountered sign into explicit named remembrance.
Fire hidden in the striking wood and then released supplies a concrete transition from latent capacity to visible benefit.
A reminder that causes recollection explicitly assigns mnemonic work to the fire.
A useful provision for needs keeps the reminder attached to practical dependence rather than detached contemplation.
The empty, resource-poor country makes portable fire a concentrated instance of sustaining provision.

structural_cues: The last example alone explicitly labels its product both reminder and practical provision immediately before the command.
The shift from 'We made it' to 'so glorify' supplies a direct object-to-response progression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden fire, its explicit mnemonic and practical functions, and the adjacent imperative; I infer that material reminder is completed by named vocal remembrance. A live alternative is that fire is only the last member of the series and the command summarizes all examples equally.

changed_reading.before: Regard fire as one more proof and then offer abstract praise.
changed_reading.after: When latent provision becomes usable in need, let the material reminder complete its work by becoming explicit remembrance of the great Lord's name.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates ٱسْم through the packet's split و س م mapping and treats naming as a rain-made mark, not merely a designation. It remains anchored in focus word 2 and is reinforced by the crop-water-growth sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a cross-root material analogy, never as the direct lexical translation of ٱسْم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بِٱسْمِ at word 2 through the packet's س م و to و س م split mapping, especially the first-rain marking branch.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation turns the name into an identifying mark whose effect becomes visibly alive.
Growth makes the rain-mark legible as a changed state rather than an inert inscription.
Delivered rain supplies the material carrier that places the mark upon the earth.
The fresh shoot gives gratitude a growth-image, allowing the received name-mark to show as a living response.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's name is a label pronounced by the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, glorification bears the Lord's name like first rain bears a mark into soil: its truth should become visible in growth and grateful response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears the focus adjective through the عَظْم 'hard bone' branch rather than replacing its ordinary greatness sense. It remains anchored in word 4 and is activated by death, replacement, and new origination. Downstream prose should call it an embodied undertone of greatness, not translate ٱلْعَظِيمِ as 'bony' or claim a lexical pun is required.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْعَظِيمِ at word 4 through the packet's ع ظ م hard-bone branch.

activation_trace.role: Hard bone supplies the creature's durable structural frame as a material resonance of greatness.
The loss of life separates a body's visible structure from the force that animated it.
One thing standing in place of another supplies structural replacement rather than mere repair.
A represented form supplies the patterned likeness through which replacement remains recognizably creaturely.
New origination supplies the power that can give the replacement pattern embodied existence.

changed_reading.before: Greatness is heard only as abstract magnitude and rank.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, greatness includes mastery over the hard structural frame: life can end, likeness can be replaced, and an embodied form can be originated anew.

strongest_changes: The final imperative becomes the conclusion of an agency audit: human handling is separated from divine origination and transformation.
رَبِّكَ gains a processual force of feeding, tending, and completing latent life across body, crop, water, and tree.
Counterfactual ruin makes ordinary preservation and usability, not only spectacular creation, an object of glorification.
The fire explicitly made reminder and provision turns material dependence into named remembrance at the point of use.
summary.what_was_special: The context converts a short doxological command into the practical conclusion of repeated causal experiments, while the focus inventories preserve two contained material resonances: the name as a rain-made living mark and greatness as mastery over embodied structure.
remaining_uncertainties: The strength of the inferential force carried by the opening result-link in 56:74 remains grammatically live.
The rain-mark and hard-bone readings are packet-anchored associations, but they should remain exploratory rather than govern direct translation.
The fire may uniquely channel reminder into utterance, or it may simply be the final instance in a summary covering the whole sequence.
